limitations: All attempted cases including negative observations and failures are preserved; no retry or sample substitution.
A/B are experimental local diagnostic copies, not official deployment or upgrade proposals.
B applies only a115965 production changes for causal isolation; the official fix sequence includes later defensive commit ec483d. B is not the complete official fix or a deployment recommendation.
This aggregation reports observations and exact intervention identity; it does not attribute all historical failures or establish a field failure rate.
NetLog closing-container repair is in memory only and does not recover absent events. Missing connection bindings are recorded as analysis errors.
No direct instrumentation of every ctx.read call; DEBUG lines are not a direct count of read invocations.
Bounded local HTTP/1.1 workaround, not a runtime code fix.
No WebSocket/SSE/streaming, write operations, all-plugin/device matrix or formal performance acceptance.
Public route bodies were hashed but not archived; the recorded route assertions are not independent body replays.
